body_es: Scrum estructura el trabajo a través de eventos time-boxed que crean ritmo y oportunidades de inspección y adaptación: el Sprint Planning establece el objetivo y selecciona trabajo; el Daily Standup sincroniza al equipo diariamente en 15 minutos; el Sprint Review demuestra incrementos completados a stakeholders; y la Sprint Retrospective permite al equipo reflexionar y mejorar su proceso. Estos eventos, cuando se ejecutan correctamente, proporcionan transparencia, fomentan la colaboración, y aseguran que el trabajo está alineado con los objetivos del negocio.
body_en: Scrum structures work through time-boxed events that create rhythm and opportunities for inspection and adaptation: Sprint Planning establishes the objective and selects work; the Daily Standup synchronizes the team daily in 15 minutes; the Sprint Review demonstrates completed increments to stakeholders; and the Sprint Retrospective allows the team to reflect and improve their process. These events, when executed correctly, provide transparency, foster collaboration, and ensure work is aligned with business objectives.
example_code:
# Scrum Events Timeline (2-week sprint)
scrum_events:
  sprint_planning:
    when: "Monday, 09:00"
    duration: "4 hours (for 2-week sprint)"
    purpose: "Define sprint goal and select user stories"
    output: "Sprint backlog"
  
  daily_standup:
    when: "Monday-Friday, 09:30"
    duration: "15 minutes (timeboxed)"
    questions:
      - "What did I complete?"
      - "What will I work on today?"
      - "Are there any blockers?"
    output: "Team synchronization"
  
  sprint_review:
    when: "Friday, 14:00"
    duration: "2 hours"
    participants: "Team + Stakeholders"
    output: "Feedback on completed work"
  
  sprint_retrospective:
    when: "Friday, 16:00"
    duration: "1.5 hours"
    focus: "What went well, what to improve"
    output: "Process improvements for next sprint"
example_output:
2-Week Sprint Schedule:
Week 1:
  Mon: Sprint Planning (2h) + Work begins
  Tue-Fri: Daily Standup (9:30am) + Development
Week 2:
  Mon-Thu: Daily Standup (9:30am) + Development
  Fri: Sprint Review (2h) → Retrospective (1.5h)
  
Total Event Time: ~10 hours per sprint
Productivity: ~35 hours of development work per sprint
